summary.text: Gene Dornink is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 23 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Angie Hanson.
He has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2021 and his career experience includes working as a union carpenter and as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Dornink was born in Minnesota and lives in Hayfield, Minnesota; he earned a degree in carpentry from Austin Vocational School, and his career experience includes working in residential construction, as a union carpenter and as a small business owner.

His Ballotpedia profile lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2021 and gives January 3, 2023, as the date he assumed office, and notes that he advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
